messages:
Omar: Hi all, Omar here (first week). On an M2 macOS Sonoma. Ran the dotfiles bootstrap and now `asdf install python 3.11.6` fails with an OpenSSL header error. Error: 'openssl/ssl.h not found'. Any quick fix?

lucy: welcome Omar! :wave: 99% chance brew deps missing or env flags. Did you run `brew install openssl@1.1 readline xz zlib pkg-config`?

Omar: yep installed those, brew prefix is /opt/homebrew. Still seeing compile error.

sam: try exporting build flags before install:
`export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"`
`export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include"`
`export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/pkgconfig"`
then `asdf install python 3.11.6`.

Omar: that fixed python, thanks! Quick node question: `asdf plugin-add nodejs` asked me to run an import script and failed with gpg errors.

lucy: run `brew install gpg pinentry-mac` then `export GPG_TTY=$(tty)` + `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring`. If pinentry prompts weird, try `gpgconf --kill gpg-agent && gpgconf --launch gpg-agent`.

dotfiles-bot: note: docker-compose override detected in repo. Bootstrap added `~/.shell_env` with recommended build flags. You can source it with `source ~/.shell_env`.

Omar: dotfiles script wrote a .tool-versions that conflicts with my global one. Will that break projects?

sam: repo-level .tool-versions are authoritative for that project. Keep your global for personal stuff. The bootstrap backs up your old file to `~/.tool-versions.backup.<ts>` if it overwrites.

Omar: last infra question: I added my SSH pubkey to GitHub. How long until repo access?

infra-bot: ONB-812 created for Omar. Infra sync runs every 20 minutes; if you need immediate access DM @sam for escalation. Also please join the infra onboarding channel.

Omar: perfect, thanks everyone — Ill finish node + python then ping if anything else dies. Appreciate the quick help :rocket:
